steps.name: Franka
steps.text: All clear!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You were right... This bunch came prepared!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You guys should pick up the pace too!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: *gasp*... Just who are you people... *pant*...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, please move faster!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Amiya, we're being pursued from behind.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do we have time to counterattack?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not at the moment...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's better to try to shake them off and avoid unnecessary battles...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Forget about the safety issue...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I need a route that can get us out of the slums to Madam Ch'en as soon as possible.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Reunion is already on our trail...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: The more ground we have to cover, the more danger we'll be in!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's easy to do. I have a route here that the enemy will never think of.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do you already have something in mind?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Of course~

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But I'll have to take a look myself first to see if my info is reliable or not.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Try to be quick about it.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Got it~ Anyway, I'll be right back!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If you need anything, please contact another Penguin Logistics agent!

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: Can I ask... where we're going?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're meeting with the L.G.D.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They will protect you.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: ...the L.G.D.?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our current mission is to safely escort you to the L.G.D., and they will provide you with protection.

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I almost believed... that you were really here to save me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, we really are...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our original plan was to ask Lungmen to entrust some of their Infected with us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But after hearing our report, the L.G.D. suddenly asked us to transfer you to them.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Besides... in Lungmen, you'll be safest under their protection.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If we don't act now, you'll be in grave peril.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Many of the Infected that were coming after you were already wearing Reunion's badge...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: I don't know anything about this 'Reunion' that you're talking about, but...

steps.name: Misha
steps.text: But I do know the L.G.D., and I've seen how they treat the Infected. If you wanted me to capture me from the beginning, you should've just said it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm sorry... But, that's really not our intention. I know there are still some misunderstandings that have to be worked out.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But no matter how bad you think we are... Please, just bear with us a bit longer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your safety takes priority over how you feel.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll explain everything if I get the chance.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: After all, there are still things that I want to know...
